# FCC amateur radio Technician exam: questions with their correct answers (2026–2030 pool)

Source: NCVEC Question Pool Committee, 2026-2030 Technician Class (Element 2) Question Pool, public release with errata of 2026-02-19 (https://ncvec.org/index.php/2026-2030-technician-question-pool), in effect 2026-07-01 to 2030-06-30. Released by NCVEC into the public domain. Only each question's keyed correct answer is kept (the three wrong choices are left out so they cannot be read as facts); answers that refer to other choices are written out. Figures T-1, T-2 and T-3 are in the separate diagrams PDF. The bracketed reference is the FCC rule (47 CFR) the question tests, where given.

## T1A

**T1A01** [97.1] Which of the following is part of the Basis and Purpose of the Amateur Radio Service?
Answer: Advancing skills in the technical and communication phases of the radio art

**T1A02** [97.1] Which agency regulates and enforces the rules for the Amateur Radio Service in the United States?
Answer: The FCC

## T5A Current and voltage: terminology and units, conductors and insulators, alternating and direct current

**T5A01** Electrical current is measured in which of the following units?
Answer: Amperes
